scope: Timer setup title/duration/Start control scaling and two centered-minimum44-point corner actions, plus bounded shared-default regressions on iPhone/iPad.

preproduct_contract.physical_action: Two opposite 2-point-inset corners of a native44x44 square centered on Start, enabled+full viewport containment+real paused15-minute/delete read-back
preproduct_contract.normal_comparison: Exact decoded pixel comparison for font-only changes. If actual minimum44point action fails and needs a target/layout fix, document intentional normal changes rather than masking them.
preproduct_contract.helpers: Individual16-point-inset reachability via existing native scroll; nonexistent future setup scroll inactive before product change. No AX hittability prerequisite for noninteractive text.

strict_normal_pixels.states: Same empty15min setup, three independent cases per device, not six distinct product views.

physical_hit_countercontrol.asserted_real_result: 15-minute countdown, pause, value870..900 seconds, delete back to setup
physical_hit_countercontrol.limits: Two inset corners do not prove an exhaustive area map or large AX/assistive targeting. Small reported AX bounds alone were not treated as a physical hit defect.

limits: Only default and largest Accessibility category; no universal language, duration boundary, intermediate-category or real-assistive-technology certification.
Large setup scrolls; not all controls are simultaneously visible. Minus/plus and5-minute preset are actual actions; no blanket all-preset/1440-minute UI claim.
Clock font participates in opt-in header scaling but is not a separate growth-contract cell.
Shared AppHeader/Pill defaults remain unchanged; recipe and prior timer regressions are bounded checks, not all-app parity.
No real Home, accounts, microphone/camera, audio playback, native alarm or new Live Activity; physical/signing hold unchanged.
